description: NULLs, NULL joins, nested joins, subqueries, CTEs, empty aggregates, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT/OFFSET, casts, timestamps, identifiers, Unicode, huge strings, and bytea parity
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "Quoted Weird Name";
sql: CREATE TABLE nm_parent (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bucket TEXT, n INT, label TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP);
CREATE TABLE nm_child (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id TEXT, score INT, note TEXT);

INSERT INTO nm_parent (id, bucket, n, label, created_at) VALUES ('p1', 'a', 1, 'alpha', '2024-02-29 01:02:03'::timestamp), ('p2', 'a', NULL, NULL, NULL), ('p3', NULL, 3, 'Ω-unicode', '1970-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp), ('p4', 'b', 4, repeat('x', 4096), '2038-01-19 03:14:07'::timestamp);
INSERT INTO nm_child (id, parent_id, score, note) VALUES ('c1', 'p1', 10, 'hit'), ('c2', 'p2', NULL, NULL), ('c3', NULL, 30, 'orphan');
SELECT id, n IS NULL AS n_is_null, label IS NULL AS label_is_null, n = NULL AS impossible FROM nm_parent ORDER BY id;
SELECT p.id, c.id, c.score FROM nm_parent p LEFT JOIN nm_child c ON p.id = c.parent_id ORDER BY p.id, c.id;
SELECT p.id, c.id FROM (nm_parent p LEFT JOIN nm_child c ON p.id = c.parent_id) LEFT JOIN nm_parent p2 ON p2.id = c.parent_id WHERE p2.id IS NULL OR p2.id = p.id ORDER BY p.id, c.id;
SELECT id FROM nm_parent WHERE id IN (SELECT parent_id FROM nm_child WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id;
WITH ranked AS (SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS count_all, COUNT(n) AS count_n FROM nm_parent GROUP BY bucket) SELECT bucket, count_all, count_n FROM ranked ORDER BY bucket NULLS FIRST;
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(n), SUM(n), AVG(n), MIN(n), MAX(n) FROM nm_parent WHERE id = 'missing';
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*), COUNT(label) FROM nm_parent GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket NULLS LAST;
SELECT id, label FROM nm_parent ORDER BY label NULLS FIRST, id LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1;
SELECT '42'::int4 AS i, 7::text AS t, '2024-02-29 01:02:03'::timestamp AS ts;
CREATE TABLE "Quoted Weird Name" ("select" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "sp ace" TEXT, "Ω" TEXT);
INSERT INTO "Quoted Weird Name" ("select", "sp ace", "Ω") VALUES ('key', 'quoted', 'unicode');
expected_difference: Current BicDB parity gaps include nested joins, NULL sort/group edge cases, quoted non-identifier-like column names, and bytea encode/decode. The fixture intentionally keeps the full SQL reproduction visible until each gap is promoted into a match fixture.
